kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنجرف (form VII)
# أَنْجَرِفُ (ʔanjarifu) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# أَنْجَرِفَ (ʔanjarifa) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# أَنْجَرِفْ (ʔanjarif) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.rif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
